items: In which eventful year was the Prophet born?
The Prophet was born in the Year of the Elephant, when Abraha marched against the Kaaba (about 570).
What was the name of the Prophet's mother?
The Prophet's mother was Aminah bint Wahb.
Where did Aminah, the Prophet's mother, die?
She died at Abwa between Mecca and Medina on the way back from visiting relatives.
Which Abyssinian woman cared for the Prophet in his childhood and whom he called 'my mother'?
Umm Ayman (Barakah) took care of the Prophet and he honoured her.
Which monk recognised signs of prophethood in the young Muhammad during a journey to Syria with Abu Talib?
The monk Bahira at Busra recognised the signs.
How old was the Prophet when he married Khadijah?
The Prophet married Khadijah at the age of 25.
How did the Prophet settle the dispute over placing the Black Stone when the Kaaba was rebuilt?
By placing it on a cloak held by the clan leaders
By placing it alone without consulting anyone
He put the stone on a cloak, had each clan leader hold an edge, and set it in place himself.
In which cave did the first revelation come?
The first revelation came in the Cave of Hira on Jabal an-Nur.
How old was the Prophet when the first revelation came?
The Prophet was 40 years old when the first revelation came.
Who is regarded as the first child to accept Islam?
Ali was a boy when he accepted Islam and is regarded as the first child to do so.
Who is regarded as the first free man to accept Islam?
Abu Bakr is regarded as the first free man to believe.
About how many years did the secret preaching in Mecca last?
The Prophet preached secretly for about three years before going public.
On which hill did the Prophet first publicly call the Meccans to Islam?
He climbed as-Safa and called the Quraysh to the worship of God alone.
Which uncle of the Prophet was most hostile towards him?
Abu Lahab opposed the Prophet and Surah Al-Masad was revealed about him.
Which Meccan leader who was killed at Badr was among the worst persecutors of the Muslims?
Abu Jahl (Amr ibn Hisham) persecuted the Muslims and was killed at Badr.
Who was the first woman martyr in Islam?
Sumayyah, wife of Yasir and mother of Ammar, died under torture without giving up her faith.
The verses that led Umar to Islam were from the beginning of which surah?
Umar heard the beginning of Surah Ta-Ha at his sister's house and accepted Islam.
Where did the Muslims and Banu Hashim live during the three-year boycott?
They endured the boycott in the Shi'b of Abu Talib in Mecca.
To which city did the Prophet go in the tenth year of his mission to invite people, where he was stoned?
In Ta'if he was stoned yet he did not curse the people.
In which event were the five daily prayers made obligatory?
The five daily prayers were ordained during the Night of the Ascension.
In which year CE did the Hijrah take place?
The Hijrah took place in 622, the start of the Islamic calendar.
Who tried to catch the Prophet on the Hijrah and whose horse sank into the ground?
Suraqah wanted the Quraysh's reward but his horse sank repeatedly, so he sought the Prophet's pardon.
Who slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the Hijrah?
Ali slept in the Prophet's bed to mislead the Quraysh.
What was the name of the Prophet's camel that knelt at the site of the Prophet's Mosque?
Qaswa knelt where the mosque and the Prophet's house were built.
In which year after the Hijrah did the Battle of Badr take place?
Badr took place in the 2nd year after the Hijrah, in Ramadan.
About how many Muslims fought at Badr?
About 313 Muslims fought, against roughly a thousand polytheists.
To whom did the Prophet hand over the key of the Kaaba at the conquest of Mecca?
The Prophet returned the key to Uthman ibn Talhah.
In which year after the Hijrah did the Farewell Pilgrimage take place?
The Farewell Pilgrimage took place in the 10th year, shortly before his passing.
In whose room was the Prophet buried?
He was buried in the room where he passed away, Aisha's room.
Who was the mother of the Prophet's son Ibrahim?
Ibrahim was born to Mariyah the Copt and died in infancy.
How many daughters did the Prophet have?
He had four daughters: Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatimah.
Which caliph is called 'Dhun-Nurayn' (Possessor of Two Lights) for marrying two of the Prophet's daughters?
Uthman married Ruqayyah and later Umm Kulthum.
Which title meaning 'the one who distinguishes truth from falsehood' was given to Umar?
Which title meaning 'the truthful' was given to Abu Bakr?
Abu Bakr was called as-Siddiq for believing the Prophet without hesitation.
Who narrated the largest number of hadiths among the companions?
Abu Hurayrah narrated the most hadiths.
What are the ten companions who were given the glad tidings of Paradise during their lives called?
They are known as the Ten Promised Paradise.
What was Medina called before Islam?
Medina was called Yathrib before the Hijrah.
Which two Arab tribes made up the Ansar of Medina?
The Ansar came from the Aws and the Khazraj.
What title did the Christian king who sheltered the Muslim migrants in Abyssinia hold?
The Negus did not hand the Muslims over to the Quraysh's envoys.
Who was known as the leader of the hypocrites in Medina?
Abdullah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul led the hypocrites.
Which Jewish tribe was expelled from Medina first?
Banu Qaynuqa broke the pact after Badr and was exiled.
In which year after the Hijrah was Khaybar conquered?
Khaybar fell in the 7th year after Hudaybiyah.
Which companion carried the Prophet's letter to Heraclius, the Byzantine emperor?
Dihyah al-Kalbi delivered the letter to Heraclius.
Which scribe of the revelation led the effort to collect the Quran into a single volume?
Zayd ibn Thabit led the compilation under Abu Bakr and Uthman.
Which grandfather of the Prophet re-dug the well of Zamzam?
In which city did the Prophet pass away?
He passed away in Medina in the 11th year after the Hijrah.
In which valley did the Prophet lead his first Friday prayer before entering Medina?
He led the first Friday prayer in Wadi Ranuna among Banu Salim.
Who owned the land where the Prophet's Mosque was built?
The Prophet bought the land from the orphans Sahl and Suhayl.
Which companion spoke for the Muslims before the Negus and recited from Surah Maryam?
Ja'far spoke for the Muslims and recited verses of Surah Maryam.
